permission.description: Specifies constants defining an access permission, as granted to grantees in an AccessControlList.

canonicalGrantee.description: A canonical grantee is a grantee identified by their canonical Amazon ID.

emailGrantee.description: An e-mail grantee is a grantee identified by their e-mail address and authenticated by an Amazon system.

groupGrantee.description: A group grantee is a group of Amazon S3 users who can be granted permissions to Amazon S3 buckets and objects.

title: A grant consists of one grantee and one permission.
name: AwsS3Grant
